purpose: Measure whether the optional Ask pipeline stages improve retrieval on the frozen benchmark, and how the faithfulness gate scores, BEFORE any flag is enabled.
no_model_calls: No Gemini or other language-model API call is made in this experiment (stage A and the faithfulness pilot).
stage_b_not_included: A shadow run of the faithfulness gate on freshly generated answers (about 139 Gemini calls) is NOT part of this registration and needs separate approval and a quota check.

questions.headline: PRIMARY_ANSWERABLE (133)
questions.gold: frozen bm25_v1.0 gold cue sets (baseline preprocessing) for ALL arms; a cue removed by cleaning counts as not covered

ranking.R0_bm25: frozen raw BM25 ranking (must reproduce the saved baseline exactly)
ranking.R1_bm25_asr: the same BM25 on ASR-cleaned captions (qa.asr_cleanup.sanitize_segments)
ranking.R2_rrf: BM25 (positive scores) + dense (MiniLM) fused with RRF k=60, all chunks ranked (HybridSelector.rank_chunks)
ranking.R3_rrf_rerank: top 12 fused chunks reordered by the cross-encoder, then the remaining fused chunks

evidence.A1_hybrid: AskService with HybridSelector (12 candidates, keep 4, offline models)

arms.evidence_method: AskService.answer with a recording stand-in model; the final EvidencePlan is captured; no prompt tuning, no thresholds changed

metrics.ranking: frozen: Hit Rate@1/3/5, Interval Recall@1/3/5, Full-evidence coverage@1/3/5, MRR@10 (headline: Hit Rate@5 and MRR@10)
metrics.evidence: evidence_hit, interval_coverage, full_interval_coverage, strict_containment, gold_cue_fraction, gate_failure, evidence size, estimated prompt tokens

statistics.interval: question-level percentile bootstrap 95%, B=10000, seed 20261013 (frozen function); paired differences; lecture-clustered check for primary contrasts
statistics.decision_rule: improvement iff the WHOLE paired 95% interval is above 0; decline iff the whole interval is below 0; otherwise no demonstrated difference (a bound equal to 0 counts as containing 0)
statistics.multiplicity: none applied; 2 primary contrasts x 2 metrics
statistics.power_note: BM25 Hit@5 is already about 0.93 (9 misses of 133), so at most 9 questions can improve; only a large gain could reach the decision rule. This benchmark can show harm or a large gain, not a small one.

enable_rule_preregistered.for_each_flag: RECOMMEND only if ALL hold: (1) its ranking primary contrast shows 'improvement' on Hit Rate@5 or MRR@10 and 'decline' on neither; (2) its evidence contrast shows 'decline' on neither evidence_hit nor strict_containment, and gate failures do not increase; (3) latency: warm median pre-model time added versus A0 is within budget (hybrid 500 ms, ASR clean-up 50 ms) and, for hybrid, cold start is within 5 s
enable_rule_preregistered.otherwise: DO NOT ENABLE YET, and the failing criteria are listed
enable_rule_preregistered.even_if_recommended: the benchmark was already used for the earlier BM25/hybrid comparison and for production-evidence checks, so a recommendation must be confirmed on new held-out questions before permanent enabling

latency_protocol.pass_1: cold: fresh selector (model load and chunk-vector cache misses)
latency_protocol.measured: AskService.answer wall time with an instant stand-in model, and the selector call alone

faithfulness_pilot.data: the 17 existing run_1 answers of ask_prompt_b_v1 (no new calls); evidence passages rebuilt with the production code and checked against the registered prompt hashes
faithfulness_pilot.presumed_faithful_label: the AI-assisted scores of those answers (grounding = ok for all 17); NOT human-verified
synthetic_negatives: mismatch: the answer scored against another case's passages
append: the real answer plus one fabricated unrelated sentence
number: every number in the answer replaced by a different number (only answers with numbers)
faithfulness_pilot.reported: score per answer, share blocked at thresholds 0.5-1.0 (false-block rate on the 17), detection rate per negative type; NOT a precision on real hallucinations, which cannot be computed without labelled unfaithful answers

determinism: evidence plans must be identical across passes; R0 must reproduce the saved baseline metrics; R2 is compared with the saved dense_hybrid_v1 M3 rankings (agreement rate reported)
limitations: Benchmark labels are machine-drafted; 1 of 176 primary questions is video-verified.
Ranking metrics ignore the production relevance gate; evidence metrics include it.
Latency is single-machine CPU timing, pre-model only.
The cross-encoder and the faithfulness gate had not been evaluated before this experiment.
